title: First Day of a New Home Oxygen Therapy Payment Period After a Long Break
content:
# First Day of a New Payment Period After a Long Break — Home Oxygen Therapy

The new Home Oxygen Therapy payment period begins on the day the patient confirms continuing, written as YYYY-MM-DD, with the month count back at 1.

## Elements

| Element | Content |
|---|---|
| First day of the new payment period | the day the patient confirms continuing |
| Month count | back at 1: the first month of the new period is month 1 |
| Format | YYYY-MM-DD |

## Worked example (hypothetical)

A patient confirms on 3 May 2025 that the oxygen continues with Summit Ridge after a long break.

1. The new payment period begins on 3 May 2025, written 2025-05-03.
2. The month beginning 3 May 2025 is month 1 of the new period; the following anniversary, 3 June 2025, begins month 2.

## Questions answered

**Does the month count carry over from the old payment period?** No; it is back at 1.

**In what form is the first day written?** YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2025-05-03.
